description.value: Menbow Ramen Bar is an authentic Japanese ramen restaurant in downtown Victoria, part of a growing BC chain with locations on Vancouver Island and the Lower Mainland. The kitchen imports key ingredients directly from Japan and is one of the few ramen spots offering both creamy Tonkotsu (pork bone) and clear Tori (chicken) broths across multiple flavor profiles including Shio, Shoyu, Miso, and a vegetarian Tomato Ramen. Cyclists looking for a hot, filling bowl after a long ride can dine in or order pickup through the restaurant's online ordering system.
